verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the headline as a large four-line stack that fills the portrait well, but the CTA sits left while the headline is centred, and the LIMITED badge floats far to the right, cut off from the button it was attached to in the original. B leaves the headline almost touching the side edges and a huge dead orange gap in the middle. It also shrinks the CTA and badge to small, hard-to-read pills jammed into the bottom-left corner, so the CTA gets lost.
